title: EcoTrace: High-Precision Energy and Operational Carbon Emissions Instrumentation for Python
description: EcoTrace is a high-precision, open-source software energy and operational carbon emission instrumentation library for Python. It provides 50ms continuous temporal sampling, process-scoped attribution to prevent multi-tenant noise, non-linear piecewise CPU power modeling calibrated against Intel/AMD RAPL hardware counters, multi-GPU tracking via NVML, drop-in compatibility with CodeCarbon APIs (EmissionsTracker), and HuggingFace Trainer callbacks.
